intent: Research actual GitHub Actions job execution duration with causal features and sealed prospective evaluation; no production activation.

contract.source: Read-only public GitHub Actions jobs, three explicitly allowlisted JANUS repositories
contract.target: job.completed_at - job.started_at, measured seconds; excludes queue time
contract.data: job/run identifiers, original UTC timestamps, source response SHA-256 hashes and deterministic per-repo chronological splits
contract.chronology: No target may use a job whose completed_at is not strictly earlier than target started_at
contract.split: 62% train, 20% validation, 18% holdout per repository; five-job embargo at boundaries
contract.gate: Overall 5% MAE improvement over best control, per-repo 5% advantage, log MAE advantage and at least 60 holdout jobs; still provisional only
contract.real_data_launch: opt-in workflow_dispatch only, not triggered on PR
contract.independent_verifier: separate job receives sealed holdout, training receives train and validation only

next_actions: Review experimental threat model and test coverage
Run workflow_dispatch only after code review
Inspect independent report and provenance before any further conclusion
Repeat under prospective out-of-sample independent conditions
